svg.title: $ ping duongthaitan
svg.desc: A realistic Earth built from real geography, turning in orthographic projection with sunlit oceans, clouds, a night side and a glowing atmosphere, Soc Trang, Vietnam marked, and a satellite in orbit. Beside it, ping duongthaitan gets a reply from each link: github.com/duongthaitan, linkedin.com/in/duongthaitan, @thaitan.duong_.
